content: For example, when we consider two sequences "height of tom cruise" and "age of sun", while computing the attention weights between the word "height" and all the words in the second sequence it can be observed that their no matching word in the latter. In this case, a standard dot-product based attention with softmax won't be able to produce weights which is below 0.33 (=1/3) for all the words in the second sequence with respect to the word "height" in the first sequence.
